sources.title: RFC 9457 — Problem Details for HTTP APIs

claims.statement: 403 Forbidden denies a understood request, while 404 Not Found can describe a missing target resource and may also avoid disclosing a forbidden resource.

claims.statement: 409 Conflict describes a conflict with current resource state, while 500 Internal Server Error describes an unexpected server condition.
